nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 public state variable holding the Liquidity Asset token address the Loan was funded with.
Immutable public address state variable storing the Loan contract that owns this FundingLocker.
Constructor(address _liquidityAsset, address _loan) initializes the immutable liquidityAsset and loan state variables.
Modifier isLoan() that requires msg.sender == loan, guarding pull and drain with an access-control check.
External function pull(address dst, uint256 amt) guarded by isLoan that transfers amt of liquidityAsset to dst.
External function drain() guarded by isLoan that transfers the entire liquidityAsset balance of this contract to the loan.
Untrusted caller address compared against the loan state variable inside the isLoan modifier.
External token call liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt) inside pull, an arbitrary ERC20 call that can hand control to an untrusted token contract.
External token call liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt) inside drain, sending the full balance to the loan via an untrusted token contract.
External call liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) inside drain used to compute the transfer amount.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset used to set the liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter _loan used to set the loan state variable.
External parameter dst of pull, the destination of the ERC20 transfer.
External parameter amt of pull, the amount of Liquidity Asset to transfer.
Local variable amt in drain holding the contract's liquidityAsset balance prior to transfer.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the immutable liquidityAsset from the _liquidityAsset argument.
Constructor assigns the immutable loan from the _loan argument.
Constructor consumes parameter _liquidityAsset to initialize state.
Constructor consumes parameter _loan to initialize state.
Parameter _liquidityAsset flows directly into the liquidityAsset state variable.
Parameter _loan flows directly into the loan state variable.
msg.sender is compared with loan inside the isLoan modifier, controlling whether execution proceeds.
The loan state variable is read in the isLoan access-control comparison.
The isLoan modifier gates entry into pull, restricting it to the Loan contract.
The isLoan modifier gates entry into drain, restricting it to the Loan contract.
pull performs the external safeTransfer operation on liquidityAsset.
pull reads its dst parameter to build the transfer call.
pull reads its amt parameter to build the transfer call.
Untrusted destination parameter dst flows into the safeTransfer external call.
Untrusted amount parameter amt flows into the safeTransfer external call.
liquidityAsset state variable is the token target of the safeTransfer in pull.
drain performs the external safeTransfer of the full balance.
drain performs the external balanceOf query on liquidityAsset.
drain computes its local variable amt from the balance query.
liquidityAsset state variable is the token target of the balanceOf call in drain.
The loan state variable is the recipient of the safeTransfer in drain.
The external balanceOf result is stored into the local variable amt.
The local variable amt is passed as the value of the safeTransfer external call.
safeTransfer on an untrusted liquidityAsset token can call back into pull before state/effects settle.
safeTransfer on an untrusted liquidityAsset token can call back into drain before the transfer completes.

Parameter _loan is only used to initialize state inside the constructor and should be folded into it.

Parameter amt is only consumed by pull when building the safeTransfer call and should be folded into it.
Local variable amt is derived from balanceOf and fed directly into the safeTransfer in drain and should be folded into it.
